# SYQORA NEXUS — Digital Technology Studio

> SYQORA NEXUS is an elite digital engineering and technology studio co-founded by Shubham Sonkusare (Lead Software Engineer & ML Specialist) and Yamini Nandanwar (Lead Data Analyst & BI Specialist). The studio specializes in high-performance bespoke website development, modern 3D & interactive web design, commercial AI solutions & workflow automation, and executive Power BI data analytics dashboards for businesses in Nagpur and across India.

## Dedicated Service Pages

- [Website Development](https://syqora-nexus.netlify.app/website-development): High-performance bespoke web engineering with optimized Core Web Vitals, minimal layout shift, modern responsive design, local SEO schema, and continuous managed support.
- [3D & Interactive Web Design](https://syqora-nexus.netlify.app/3d-web-design): GPU-accelerated micro-animations, tactile 3D UI, WebGL shaders, smooth perspective transforms, and fluid interactive web experiences.
- [AI Solutions & Business Automation](https://syqora-nexus.netlify.app/ai-solutions): Practical AI automations, structured WhatsApp inquiry routing, automated web form logging, and rule-based validation workflows.
- [Data Analytics & Power BI Dashboards](https://syqora-nexus.netlify.app/data-analytics): Custom executive Power BI dashboards, SQL database modeling, structured data transformation models, and real-time KPI scorecards led by Yamini Nandanwar.
- [Landing Page Development](https://syqora-nexus.netlify.app/landing-page-development): High-converting single-page sales funnels, paid ad campaign landing pages (Meta & Google Ads), and lightweight, high-speed mobile lead capture systems.

- [Direct Contact & Inquiries](https://syqora-nexus.netlify.app/#contact): Instant WhatsApp and direct email channels for rapid project onboarding.
